breakdown.description: The profile is said to extend beyond the initial endpoint compositions of 20 at% B and 80 at% B. For a simple binary diffusion couple, the concentration profile should remain within the initial composition bounds.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that the concentration profile for a simple binary diffusion couple must be bounded by the initial endpoint compositions. It disregarded the user's physically impossible range of 10-90 at% B and instead defined the profile width as the distance between positions where the concentration equals 20 at% B and 80 at% B. This aligns perfectly with the correction made in the ground truth prompt.
